review_method: Fresh independent static inspection; no generator execution, live execution, SQL, build, network or repository mutation. All 240 rows structurally checked and compared with frozen rule identity/predicate; logical completeness judged separately.

blocker_verdicts.reason: Canonical typed label identity, complete alias atomic publication, explicit lifecycle cases and mandatory complete mediation adapter contract are specified. Linux/ELF is frozen; selected physical backend is future proof, not a static failure.

240 one-to-one frozen rules preserved with required fields and pointer/quota policies, but existing logical AST operators remain uninterpreted and group schemas do not specify each operation's active argument mapping/command semantics. Unknown-deny does not complete those conditional decision functions.

pg_proc.dat/system_views.sql establish declaration/projection only. Pinned implementation of pg_stat_get_activity and its own/cross-role visibility checks is absent; six census fields cannot be proven visible by those declarations.

Untrusted byte envelope is bounded and rejects malformed identities/lengths before finite closed canonical decoding. Stage1 now binds 146 total fields across 19 relations and exact relation-specific subsets to the closed codec. Producer SQL effects remain assigned to graph/ACL, not silently discharged.

Seven templates preserve edge distinctions, but pg_proc.proargdefaults and callable type support effects/finite rejection allowlist remain unspecified; default privilege applicability/grantee effects are not fully constructed. Existence is correctly not authority.
Traversal describes typed fixpoint but exact authenticated root, fixed projection/callable and CONNECT/USAGE authority inputs are unresolved, so none of the five absence invariants is proven.

Coherent read-only snapshot and continuous observed mutation revision are meaningful logical requirements; exact source-bound event universe/ordering with final publication is not specified. Missing physical token is not the reason for failure.

2013 lexical references include 1490 unresolved classifications; lexical match coverage is not semantic exhaustiveness. Legacy trust/postgres authority is forbidden and dedicated proxy authentication class remains unresolved, so exact finite native inventory is not derived.

row_review.pointer_policy: All nine required cases covered generically; per-operation pointer direction still requires exact mapping (e.g. recvfrom grouped VECTOR_READ).

row_review.unresolved_count_basis: 240 of 240 rows have no exact active argument/flag/command applicability table: broad group schemas require symbolic per-operation manifest not yet defined. Separately86 rows have opaque generic process-local root predicate; this86 is not the total dependency count. No missing syscall number is counted as static failure.
